condition:
recombinant WT encapsulin overexpressed in 
R. jostii RHA1 Δencapsulin/pTipQC2; purified assembled encapsulin-only preparation
notes:
Canonical experimentally assembled WT R. jostii RHA1 encapsulin. Rahmanpour & Bugg 2013 reported a high-Mr particle
 (~1.8 MDa by calibrated gel filtration) and a ~22 nm DLS particle size. The paper inconsistently refers to the DLS value as radius and diameter; because it directly compares 22 nm with the 24 nm diameter of T. maritima, 22 nm is retained here as the reported particle diameter with this ambiguity noted. Jones & Giessen 2021 classify the R. jostii shell as a 60-subunit T=1 encapsulin; icosahedral symmetry, T=1 and 60 subunits are therefore recorded as supported inferences rather than direct structural measurements. Acid-induced disassembly and neutral-pH reassembly produced a ~31 nm DLS particle, but this was not structurally characterized as a distinct expanded assembly.
shell_sequence_change: No engineered alteration of the WT shell protein is recorded for this assembly.
